description: Record an observation for or against a statement. Required: agent_id, proposition, supported (true = this observation agrees with it). Optional: brain_id, episode_id, source. Confidence is computed, never passed in — it moves toward the evidence in shrinking steps and drops faster on a contradiction than it rises on a confirmation, so a statement can never become unfalsifiable. A statement that directly contradicts an existing one is reported back rather than stored silently alongside it.

proposition.description: The statement the observation is evidence for or against

supported.description: true = the observation agrees with the statement, false = contradicts it

name: record_belief
